meta.name: google-cloud-recipe-onboarding
meta.description: Guides a developer's first steps on Google Cloud, covering account creation, billing setup, project management, and deploying a first resource. Use when a new developer wants to initialize their first Google Cloud project, configure billing, and verify deployment. Don't use for enterprise organization setup (use Google Cloud Setup guided flow for that instead). Don't use for complex multi-project architectures.

copy.tagline: 引导新手完成谷歌云账号创建、结算设置和首次部署
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是谷歌云新手，需要一步步完成账号开通和首个资源部署
copy.tagline_en: Guide new users through Google Cloud account creation, billing setup, and first deployment

howto.what: Claude 会引导你完成 Google Cloud 的初始设置，包括检查环境、登录认证、选择或创建项目、关联结算账户，并验证部署。
howto.when: 当你表示想开始使用 Google Cloud，例如说“我想开始用 Google Cloud”时触发。

say.text: 我想开始用 Google Cloud，帮我设置一下。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成账号创建和认证。

say.text: 帮我创建一个新项目并关联结算账户。
say.note: Claude 会询问项目名称并执行创建和关联。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through initial Google Cloud setup: checking environment, authenticating, selecting or creating a project, linking a billing account, and verifying deployment.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you express intent to start using Google Cloud, e.g., saying "I want to get started with Google Cloud."

say_en.text: I want to get started with Google Cloud, help me set it up.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through account creation and authentication.

say_en.text: Create a new project and link a billing account for me.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for project details and execute creation and linking.
